prompts.voltPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a compact animation model sheet of original DJ Volt for a music app, on a genuinely transparent background. Four complete full-body drawings in a single evenly spaced horizontal row, identical scale and costume. Street-skating pirate radio DJ, youthful adult male with warm brown skin, sharp expressive face, lime swept spiky hair, cyan goggles pushed onto forehead, oversized hot pink headphones, oversized orange sleeveless basketball jersey marked 99, loose purple cargo trousers, huge ivory inline skates with cyan details and pink wheels, handheld dark microphone. Sophisticated angular early-2000s cel shaded game concept art, confident graphic silhouette, long lanky limbs, small head roughly 1:7 body proportion, bold dark ink contours, decisive flat shadows, no chibi proportions. Inspired by futuristic graffiti skating and extreme sports concept art, original design no franchise characters. Fixed front three-quarter view facing slightly to viewer right. Pose 1 relaxed listening, mic low, free hand near ear; pose 2 knees lightly flexed and shoulders dipped, hand still at ear; pose 3 gentle groove leaning left with mic at chest; pose 4 groove leaning right with mic at chest. Every complete head hand and wheel visible, generous gutters and margins. Feet on same ground line. No labels, no background, no panels, no floor shadow. Keep details uncluttered for rendering at 180 pixels tall. This is the identity and pose study, not a detached parts sheet.
prompts.idlePrompt: Create a production animation sprite sheet matching DJ Volt in the reference image exactly. Use the first standing figure as identity. Transparent background. EXACTLY 12 complete body figures in a precise 4 column by 3 row regular grid, read left to right top to bottom, equal cell size, ample margins within each cell, no labels or lines. Canvas landscape 1536x1536 or larger square. These are consecutive in-between drawings of ONE small smooth idle listening movement, not different poses. Same front three-quarter view facing right, same scale throughout, both inline skates stay planted at exactly the same positions in each cell. Keep full hair and wheels inside each cell. One hand lightly touches headphones throughout and other hand holds microphone low at hip throughout. Frames 1-6: slowly soften knees and lower shoulders by only 2 percent of body height, tiny head nod and relaxed breath. Frames 7-12: smoothly return to exact frame 1 standing pose. Head rotates only 3 degrees, hair and clothing slightly follow through. Do NOT make big pose changes. Preserve warm brown skin, lime hair, cyan forehead goggles, pink headphones, orange 99 jersey, purple cargo pants, cream cyan inline skates with pink wheels. Keep same hand holding microphone throughout. Crisp ink contours flat cel shading. No shadows backgrounds extra anatomy or detached parts. This is a seamless subtle breathing/listening loop with closely spaced whole-body drawings.

prompts.sequencePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Animation sprite sheet of the ASIAN MALE DJ Volt in the attached reference, light-medium warm skin, same East Asian face and original costume. EXACTLY 16 full-body drawings arranged 4 columns by 4 rows on TRANSPARENT EMPTY background (alpha zero, NO colored haze or scenery). Fixed scale and view, identical long-limbed proportions and same costume in EVERY frame. Generous gutters, full hair and all skate wheels visible inside each cell. Simplify small clothing details. Orange 99 jersey, purple pants, lime hair, cyan goggles, pink headphones, white cyan pink inline skates. Anatomical right hand (viewer left) holds mic in every drawing.
This sheet is a smooth continuous sequence of closely spaced poses, numbered here ONLY for your planning; do not print numbers:
Frames 1-4 row 1: very subtle idle breathing, left hand touching headphone, mic low at right hip, knees gently soften by 1 percent height then recover. Same stance and foot locations.
Frames 5-12 rows 2-3: eight evenly spaced in-between drawings transitioning from that idle pose: right arm progressively bends to lift microphone from hip to mouth, left arm progressively lowers from headphone to a relaxed outward gesture at waist height. Keep both feet in the exact idle positions. All stages gradual including first and last steps.
Frames 13-16 row 4: four small successive groove poses, microphone at mouth and free hand out, shoulders gradually lean to viewer left and knees soften, weight sinks by 3 percent height, feet remain at same ground line.
Original cel animation, crisp clean ink, flat colored shadows, early 2000s stylish skating-game artwork. Identity must match reference Asian man. No disconnected parts, no labels, no grids, no ground shadows, no per-frame zoom. Very consistent head size, limbs, clothing, foot placement.

prompts.dancePrompt:
Production seamless dance-loop sprite sheet: EXACTLY 12 consecutive drawings, 4 columns x 3 rows, genuinely transparent background. Same Asian male DJ Volt from reference, same fixed front three-quarter view, same orange 99 jersey purple cargo pants lime hair pink headphones cyan forehead goggles cream inline skates with pink wheels. Mic stays in anatomical RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT), held at mouth; free left hand relaxed out to side at waist. Start from third-row first figure of reference. All consecutive frames closely spaced, loop closure close. NO mic hand switching. Crisp flat cel shading, dark outlines, simplified details to avoid flicker.
